| **Rank7IdentityCasting5** | Conduct the five-spell conference and address its **24 explicit questions**, retaining actual class access and source-specific restrictions. |
| **Copied-feat release integration** | Review the existing commitment/release implementation against its accepted contracts and the newly drafted Ready correction. Identify necessary changes without reopening settled rules. |
| **Copied-feat recipient effects** | Review the supplied health, buff and movement integrations for transaction ordering, lifecycle, cleanup and source-specific interactions. |
| **Copied-feat class providers** | Review the actual Shaman and Mirrorsage integrations, including resource ownership, concentration and shared allowances. Check them against the new cross-round Ready choice without assuming that choice is already implemented. |

**That includes 11 additional spell identities with 44 unanswered conference questions**, plus the three implementation-evidence packages. Their presence makes them available for review—not automatically correct or accepted.

There is also further work on the existing correction package: converting its remaining integration obligations into more complete source-qualified test specifications and checking dependent documents for concrete contradictions. The previous pass supplied **ten integration cases that have not been executed in the actual runtime**. :chatgpt-content-reference{index="1"}

## What actually requires something else

**Closing all of Control15 requires its missing exact source material.** The last pass had the complete draft but only **35 of its 54 bound source files**. That limits whole-cohort acceptance; it does **not** prevent work on other complete packages. :chatgpt-content-reference{index="2"}

**Command Undeath still needs qualifying creature content.** Its accepted procedure does not supply an operative Undead creature with CR exactly 2, so its two positive-case holds cannot be cleared by additional wording or by borrowing a generated summon’s assumed rating. :chatgpt-content-reference{index="3"}

**Production implementation and actual engine validation remain separate.** You reserved implementation for Codex after your instruction. The reference models and checks in my package are specifications, not replacement game-engine code. Human gameplay and numerical balance also remain uncompleted gates. :chatgpt-content-reference{index="4"}

## The next useful sequence

My priority would be to **check the three copied-feat integrations against the new Ready decision first**, because that directly affects the correction package you will hand to Codex. Then proceed through **Rank8Damage6 and Rank7IdentityCasting5**, producing separately bound corrections and decisions.

**You do not need to instruct Codex to implement the last package before that review work continues. The available material has not been exhausted, and the last delivery was a checkpoint—not the end of what can be corrected now.**

## Four scoped choices expressly concurred with

**`CL10-SOULBURN-RESERVOIR-04` — accepted.** Soulburn’s own selected 0–3 RP output may resolve on a qualifying Grand Reservoir cast. This is the disclosed local interpretation, not a claim that the Wizard card explicitly names Soulburn or generally permits recovery/refund combinations.

The Wizard must have the actual level-20 acquisition, an eligible recorded spell and an unused **1/long-rest** Reservoir use. Only the normal **7 RP base** is waived. The positive fixture therefore lawfully proceeds from **RP 0 / HP 31**, through commitment at **0 / 11**, to successful selected recovery at **3 / 11**, with Reservoir spent. Choosing zero remains legal; the original zero-output comparator is preserved.

**`CL10-WRAITH-HANDLING-04` — accepted.** This generated Wraith has two usable ordinary gripping extremities. That supplies the required mundane handling capability, not weapon proficiency, skilled work, an extra interaction or another action. The chest is deposited at the **actual current entry-side location** before otherwise obstructed traversal; no remote drop or cargo phasing is created.

Its own carrying constraints remain **90 lb and 6 Load**, independently enforced. **`CL10-GHAST-CONE-04` — accepted.** The Ghast’s Exhale uses the disclosed actual oral outlet and fixed direction, with axial distance \(0<s\leq15\) feet and radial condition \(r^2\leq(s/2)^2\). Eligibility requires actual body-interior intersection and line of effect from the same outlet to a point in that intersection. Mere exterior touching is insufficient.

This remains **Ghast-only geometry**, not an inherited or universal DI7 convention. The complete fixture retains its shared **2d6 = 7** pool, resulting in **3 damage on the successful CON save and 7 on failure**. No lingering gas, Poisoned condition, extra attack, proficiency or creature rating is added.
